## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1's DSpark draft head shards `markov_w2` over TP and, for every draft token, all-gathers its fp32 step logits (`[bs, vocab/TP]`) before sampling. At bs=1 that is a 129 KB shard per rank going through the NCCL ring at 13–18 µs, five times per verify cycle (~75 µs), plus a 5 µs NCCL broadcast of each sampled token.
